claims.claim_text: IonQ names the United States Air Force Research Lab (AFRL) as a named government customer / partner — IonQ's AFRL trapped-ion / quantum-networking work (PIID FA8750-22-C-1022, awarded by AFRL Rome FA8750 contracting office) is the company's flagship DoD program-of-record narrative.
claims.subject: IonQ, Inc. (incl. IonQ Federal, LLC)
claims.source_quote: Our customers, potential customers and partners include government agencies such as the United States Air Force Research Lab, Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency and Oak Ridge National Laboratory. Government agencies and large organizations often undertake a significant evaluation process. Our contracts with government agencies are typically structured in phases, with each phase subject to satisfaction of certain conditions and risks...

claims.claim_text: Forward-looking revenue: IonQ states its anticipated future revenues from the U.S. government result from contracts awarded under various U.S. government programs, that government cost-cutting/consolidation is a major initiative that could reduce these revenues, and reports $370.0M in remaining performance obligations (RPO) as of Dec 31 2025 including BOTH funded and UNFUNDED orders.
claims.subject: IonQ, Inc.
claims.object_value: $370.0M RPO (mix funded + unfunded); ~40% to be recognized over next 12 months
claims.source_quote: Our anticipated future revenues from the U.S. government result from contracts awarded under various U.S. government programs. Cost cutting, including through consolidation and elimination of duplicative organizations, has become a major initiative for certain departments within the U.S. government. ... As of December 31, 2025, approximately $370.0 million of revenue is expected to be recognized from remaining performance obligations that are unsatisfied (or partially unsatisfied), including both funded (firm orders for which funding has been both authorized and appropriated by the customer) and unfunded (firm orders for which funding has not been appropriated) orders.

claims.claim_text: Customer concentration: three customers represented 53% of IonQ's total revenue in FY2025 (vs two = 77% in FY2024 and two = 58% in FY2023), and IonQ states it expects increasing revenue concentration among major customers in the near term.
claims.subject: IonQ, Inc.
claims.object_value: 3 customers = 53% of FY2025 revenue ($130.0M total); concentration expected to increase
claims.source_quote: Significant customers are those that represent more than 10% of the Company's total revenue. For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, the Company had three, two, and two significant customers, respectively, that accounted for 53%, 77%, and 58% of total revenue, respectively. ... We have a high degree of revenue concentration, and we expect to continue to experience significant revenue concentration for the foreseeable future, including increasing revenue concentration among our major customers in the near term.

claims.claim_text: IonQ describes its Qubitekk acquisition (Dec 2024, now Qubitekk Federal, LLC) as a strategic federal-contracting vehicle for quantum networking — Qubitekk Federal continues to hold AFRL quantum-networking work.
claims.subject: Qubitekk Federal, LLC (IonQ subsidiary)
claims.object_value: Qubitekk Federal, LLC acquired Dec 27 2024 with customer-relationships intangible

claims.claim_text: IonQ's Capella Space subsidiary provides a satellite-based data-as-a-service product based on synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imaging, positioned as a federal/commercial customer pipeline including future positioning, navigation and timing (PNT) services. Capella received PIID FA8810-21-C-0026 ('Space Pitch Day 2021') from Space Systems Command.
claims.subject: Capella Space Corp. (IonQ subsidiary)
claims.object_value: SAR data-as-a-service + future quantum PNT; Space Pitch Day 2021 contract
claims.source_quote: Our Capella Space Corp. subsidiary also provides a satellite-based data-as-a-service product to customers based on synthetic aperture radar, or SAR, imaging. ... through combining our satellite platform with our quantum sensing products, we intend to offer advanced quantum positioning, navigation and timing services in the future.

claims.claim_text: IonQ names DARPA as a co-development partner: 'IonQ has announced co-development agreements with ... the US Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency to help establish the next generation of benchmarking for quantum computers.'
claims.subject: IonQ, Inc.
claims.source_quote: IonQ has announced co-development agreements with Ansys for computer aided design and engineering, the Centre for Commercialization of Regenerative Medicine, for advanced therapeutics optimization, and with the US Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency to help establish the next generation of benchmarking for quantum computers.

claims.claim_text: IonQ books substantial revenue from outside the U.S. — Switzerland (presumably ID Quantique, FY25 $16.6M, up from $1.5M in FY24) and Other International ($26.4M FY25 vs $0.8M FY24). FY25 U.S. revenue $87.0M of $130.0M total = 67% domestic. The non-U.S. uplift in FY25 is acquisition-driven (ID Quantique closed Apr 30, 2025).
claims.subject: IonQ, Inc. (incl. id Quantique SA)
claims.object_value: FY25 geographic split: US $87.0M / Switzerland $16.6M / Other Intl $26.4M = $130.0M
claims.source_quote: United States $86,957 $40,714 $18,703 Switzerland 16,630 1,547 646 Other international 26,429 812 2,693 Total revenue $130,016 $43,073 $22,042

claims.claim_text: Acquisition cohesion: in 2025 IonQ acquired ID Quantique (Apr 2025), Lightsynq (May 2025), Capella Space (Jul 2025), Oxford Ionics (Sep 2025), Vector Atomic (Oct 2025) and announced Skyloom Global (Jan 2026) and SkyWater Technologies (Jan 2026 pending) — an unusually large 7-deal sprint that the company frames as accelerating quantum networking/sensing/security and a 'secure quantum foundry.'
claims.subject: IonQ, Inc.
claims.object_value: 7 acquisitions announced in ~12 months: ID Quantique, Lightsynq, Capella, Oxford Ionics, Vector Atomic, Skyloom, SkyWater (pending)
claims.source_quote: In the past year, we have moved to accelerate our roadmap and cement our position as the world's only quantum platform company, and its leading quantum computing company, by hiring world class talent and acquiring complementary businesses. ... We also cemented our leadership in quantum networking, quantum sensing and quantum security with our acquisitions of id Quantique SA, Vector Atomic, Inc., Capella Space Corp. in 2025, and of Skyloom Global Corp. in January 2026. Similarly, on January 26, 2026, we announced the currently-pending acquisition ... of SkyWater Technologies, Inc.

claims.claim_text: IonQ claims an extensive patent portfolio: 'As of January 31, 2026, we own or control 610 issued patents and 514 pending patent applications, with expiration dates through 2043.' This is a non-J-Book control claim.
claims.subject: IonQ, Inc.
claims.source_quote: As of January 31, 2026, we own or control 610 issued patents and 514 pending patent applications, with expiration dates through 2043. We own or control 113 registered U.S. or international trademarks and 19 pending U.S. or international trademark applications.

claims.claim_text: Facilities: IonQ leases 32,000 sq ft in College Park MD (HQ, University of Maryland), 101,000 sq ft in Bothell WA, and 30,000 sq ft in Oxford UK. This is a non-J-Book control claim about physical footprint.
claims.subject: IonQ, Inc.
claims.source_quote: Our corporate headquarters is located in College Park, Maryland, where we lease approximately 32,000 square feet of space from the University of Maryland under an agreement that expires in 2030. We also lease approximately 101,000 square feet of space in Bothell, Washington under an agreement that expires in 2030, and approximately 30,000 square feet of space in Oxford, United Kingdom, under an agreement that expires in 2034.
